{{- /* layouts/_partials/base-url-path.html Path prefix of .Site.BaseURL, no leading/trailing slash. Contract (arch/03): baseURL is always a root-relative path — never scheme/host. / → "" /demo/quartz/ → demo/quartz /s/a7x9Q2/ → s/a7x9Q2 Absolute URLs are stripped if present (legacy share / Foundry RelPermalink when someone passed https://… as baseURL). Do not rely on that input. */ -}} {{- $raw := .Site.BaseURL | default "/" -}} {{- $path := $raw -}} {{- if or (strings.HasPrefix $raw "https://") (strings.HasPrefix $raw "http://") -}} {{- $rest := $raw | strings.TrimPrefix "https://" | strings.TrimPrefix "http://" -}} {{- $segs := split $rest "/" -}} {{- $path = "" -}} {{- range $i, $s := $segs -}} {{- if gt $i 0 -}} {{- $path = printf "%s/%s" $path $s -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return ($path | strings.TrimPrefix "/" | strings.TrimSuffix "/") -}}
